title: Stubba
extract:
The Stubba is a compact Grineer submachine gun with a medium fire rate and a good magazine size. Its reliance on  Slash and  Impact as its main damage sources allows bleeding and stunning, with help from its good critical stats.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (23.00%)
High magazine size (57)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Above average reload speed (1.30 s)
High ammo max (399)
Above average fire rate (6.33 attacks/sec)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.35x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fairly low ammo economy.
Noticeable recoil, which can throw off precision aiming.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average burst DPS (252.13)
Below average sustained DPS (220.32)
Low damage per shot (39.83)
Below average total damage (33)
Low accuracy (0.50° to 12.00°)
Below average status chance (13.00%)
Low crit multiplier (1.90x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Stubba (Normal Attack), compared to  Kuva Twin Stubbas (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage per projectile (33.00 vs. 27.00) (excluding any Progenitor bonus)
Higher  Impact damage ( 14.19 vs.  11.61)
Higher  Puncture damage ( 3.3 vs.  2.7)
Higher  Slash damage ( 15.51 vs.  12.69)
Lower total damage (using max +60% Progenitor bonus if applicable) (33 vs. 43.2)
Lower base status chance (13.00% vs. 31.00%)
Lower average damage per tap (using max +60% Progenitor bonus if applicable) (39.83 vs. 52.14)
Lower burst DPS (using max +60% Progenitor bonus if applicable) (252.13 vs. 521.42)
Lower sustained DPS (using max +60% Progenitor bonus if applicable) (220.32 vs. 421.57)
Lower fire rate (6.33 attacks/sec vs. 10.00 attacks/sec)
Smaller magazine (57 vs. 114)
Smaller max ammo capacity (399 vs. 684)
Faster reload time (1.30 s vs. 2.70 s)
Less accurate (16 vs. 36.4)
Wider maximum spread (12.00° vs. 6.00°)
Lower Mastery Rank required (7 vs. 13)
Higher disposition (●●●●● (1.35x) vs. ●●●○○ (1.00x))

Acquisition
The Stubba's blueprint can be acquired as a reward from performing special Ghoul Purge Bounties or dropped by Ghoul Rictus Alphas. It can also be bought from the Market individually, or as part of the Maggor Assault Pack.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
When the weapon is emptied to around 25% of the maximum capacity, it emits a whine that rises in pitch until depleted.

Trivia
The Stubba was called the Grineer Uzi during its TennoCon 2017 reveal.
The Uzi is a compact Israeli sub-machine gun which fills a similar role to the Stubba and can be seen as its real-life counterpart.
The Grineer script on the ammo fuel cell reads " 2 1TA".
